name: Serenity
overview: Serenity, as revealed in Scripture, is deeply connected to trusting in the Lord wholeheartedly and relying not on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. Isaiah 26:3 promises perfect peace to those whose minds are steadfastly focused on God and who place their trust in Him. This peace is grounded in the unchanging and enduring truth of God's word, affirmed in Psalms 119:89 and 119:160. Furthermore, living with serenity involves walking humbly with God and embracing His righteous requirements, as Micah 6:8 highlights.
